title: Pilk Dane Showdown

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Yo. What can I do for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yo. What can I do for you?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Who?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: They're lazy, these kids. But if they'd just listen, they could learn a lot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're lazy, these kids. But if they'd just listen, they could learn a lot.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Look, I'm a trained professional, OK? Every night I get up on that stage. I'm ready for anything. I'm a savage. You don't want to catch my eye when I'm up there. I'm a comedic assassin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm a trained professional, OK? Every night I get up on that stage. I'm ready for anything. I'm a savage. You don't want to catch my eye when I'm up there. I'm a comedic assassin.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: What are your credentials? If you're going to tag in for Deeala, I need to know you have some professional experience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are your credentials? If you're going to tag in for Deeala, I need to know you have some professional experience.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Angry customers? That's hardly on my level. Are you sure you'll be able to keep up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Angry customers? That's hardly on my level. Are you sure you'll be able to keep up?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: But I need HER help. Not you. Who are you supposed to be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I need HER help. Not you. Who are you supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Well good. I hope you're not easily offended. My comedy is for people who can take a joke. Not like the young generation. My routine has TEETH!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well good. I hope you're not easily offended. My comedy is for people who can take a joke. Not like the young generation. My routine has TEETH!

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Let's see how you do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's see how you do.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No. This time you should seek to make Mr Dane angry. The more he considers you an enemy, the better you are doing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. This time you should seek to make Mr Dane angry. The more he considers you an enemy, the better you are doing.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Precisely. You must embarrass him so badly he will never admit you beat him, and then he will, hopefully, leave her alone. Can you do this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Precisely. You must embarrass him so badly he will never admit you beat him, and then he will, hopefully, leave her alone. Can you do this?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I'll go first, then you come back at me. My three most savage observations are coming your way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll go first, then you come back at me. My three most savage observations are coming your way.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Alright, well, let's get the elephant in the room out of the way first.... And I don't mean your mom!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, well, let's get the elephant in the room out of the way first.... And I don't mean your mom!

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Alright, hope you're ready to be my comedic punching bag! I just need a tune-up before my big performance tonight. You ready?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, hope you're ready to be my comedic punching bag! I just need a tune-up before my big performance tonight. You ready?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Yeah that's me! You want an autograph? Well, I'm not really doing that. Too many fans hassling me. Well... maybe just this one time. You seem like a good kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah that's me! You want an autograph? Well, I'm not really doing that. Too many fans hassling me. Well... maybe just this one time. You seem like a good kid.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: You have? Well, I've never heard of you. Maybe you're one of those underground comedians. But if you think you can keep up...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have? Well, I've never heard of you. Maybe you're one of those underground comedians. But if you think you can keep up...?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: So NO real qualifications. Well, I didn't study this either. School of hard knocks! Maybe you're a natural like me. Do you think you can keep up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So NO real qualifications. Well, I didn't study this either. School of hard knocks! Maybe you're a natural like me. Do you think you can keep up?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: But you're the kinda business owner that I could sell donuts to, and charge extra for the holes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you're the kinda business owner that I could sell donuts to, and charge extra for the holes.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: And finally, I hear you and Deeala are really hitting it off. And by that, I mean she is HITTING on you to pay OFF her debt!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And finally, I hear you and Deeala are really hitting it off. And by that, I mean she is HITTING on you to pay OFF her debt!

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I heard you're running a noodle stand. But people keep throwing up. That's because when people said, "Show us your noods", you send them a photo of yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I heard you're running a noodle stand. But people keep throwing up. That's because when people said, "Show us your noods", you send them a photo of yourself.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Gimme your worst! I can't wait to see you stutter and fail as you try to find something - ANYTHING - to use against me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gimme your worst! I can't wait to see you stutter and fail as you try to find something - ANYTHING - to use against me.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: What... what the fuck is wrong with you? Seriously, what's your problem? How could you say something like that to another human being.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What... what the fuck is wrong with you? Seriously, what's your problem? How could you say something like that to another human being.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Alright. I can see you're still standing. Somehow! Now come at me with what you got.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. I can see you're still standing. Somehow! Now come at me with what you got.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Someone with a soul and dreams and hope and a heart... Well, until you ripped it out of my chest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone with a soul and dreams and hope and a heart... Well, until you ripped it out of my chest.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I need to go. I have to call my mom. What the fuck... What the fuck am I going to do with my life now? I'm ruined. I'm done... I'm... Fuck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to go. I have to call my mom. What the fuck... What the fuck am I going to do with my life now? I'm ruined. I'm done... I'm... Fuck.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Right... Right! I remember. I was going to teach her how to be funnier. Pass on some of my skills to the younger generation, you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... Right! I remember. I was going to teach her how to be funnier. Pass on some of my skills to the younger generation, you know.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: You get to comeback after I'm done. If you're still standing. I gotta say, Deeala owes you for this. You're in over your head, kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You get to comeback after I'm done. If you're still standing. I gotta say, Deeala owes you for this. You're in over your head, kid.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Naked! Got it? Noods - Nudes ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Naked! Got it? Noods - Nudes ...

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: And don't get me started on your business skills. I'm not saying you're bad at making deals ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And don't get me started on your business skills. I'm not saying you're bad at making deals ...

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I've got thicker skin than this younger generation. You can't upset me unless you find the perfect line.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've got thicker skin than this younger generation. You can't upset me unless you find the perfect line.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the comedian Pilk Dane.

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wasn't she supposed to teach you?
